QuestInfo.name: Tracking the Test Subject
QuestInfo.0: Find Claudine in Secret Plaza, Edelstein.
QuestInfo.1: Claudine seems flustered. She says Vita, who was recently rescued from the Black Wings' laboratory, started acting weird and disappeared. Claudine refuses your offer to help find Vita, claiming the Resistance can take care of yourself. This is a dead end... Maybe you should find Headmaster Ferdi.
QuestInfo.2: Claudine had other things on her mind. Vita, who was recently rescued from the Black Wings, started acting weird and disappeared. When you offered to help find her, Claudine refused your help, claiming the Resistance could take care of their own. Headmaster Ferdi was hesitant to act in this age of chaos. As you were speaking with Ferdi, a massive explosion from the mine rocked the town.\n#bClaudine should know what's going on.

0.0: So, you're still here. Please do stay out of our way, would you? I have no time to waste on the likes of you right now.\r\n#L0##bIt seems more chaotic around here...did something happen?#l\n#k
0.1: Vita...a girl we rescued from the Black Wings Laboratory has disappeared. We were supposed to protect her... Everything's fallen apart since you outsiders started coming here! My decision is final, so why don't you go back to where you came from already? ...Where could Vita have gone...\r\n#L0##bLet me help you.#l\n#k
0.2: No. I'm not entrusting her safety to an outsider.

1.0: Oh, it's you. Claudine mentioned you might come around. She says you're only here because you need something from us...but I'd like to give you the benefit of the doubt. I'd love to hear your reasons for visiting, but I'm afraid I haven't the time just now. \nI pray we'll have a chance to speak at length soon.

yes.0: #b(A distant explosion shakes the earth.)#k\nWh-what was--?! That came from the mines!! W-we had people searching for Vita out there... What happened?

npc.0: I have nothing more to say to you. Speak with Headmaster Ferdi in town. He will tell you the best way to leave without drawing...undue attention.
